Name: Total Frames
Explanation: Total Frames of a skill/attack (counting for hitlag)

Name: Frame Perfect Buffer
Explanation: The exact frame the game transitions into a new move (doesn't count for hitlag)

Name: Hit Instance/s
Explanation: How many hits there are in a skill/attack

Name: HitLag
Explanation: How many frames a hit slows down an animation

Name: Earliest Frame Until Cancel
Explanation: The earliest frame until you can cancel a move with all hit instance/s hitting (not including Ult Cancel unless specified)

Name: Frames Until Last Hit Instance
Explanation: The exact frame until the last hit instance collides with the enemy

Name: Endlag
Explanation: Total Frames - Earliest Frame Until Cancel

Name: EndSkill
Explanation: The frame wherein the game considers this skill as "over"

Name: Invincible (f)
Explanation: How many frames a resonator is invincible (cannot be damaged)

Name: NoInterruption (f)
Explanation: How many frames a resonator is immune to interruption

Name: NoSwap (f)
Explanation: How many frames a resonator is not able to swap into another resonator

Name: QTE (f)
Explanation: How many frames a skill is considered an Intro Skill

Name: Dodge (f)
Explanation: How many frames a skill is considered a Dodge Skill

Name: Time Stop (f)
Explanation: How many frames time is stopped

Name: Enemy Stop (f)
Explanation: How many frames enemies are stopped
